title: 长期学习效果与主动支持

sources.title: StudentBench
sources.locator: Randomized human GRE learning-gain study; limitations

research_failure.condition: Thirty virtual days with learned knowledge-tracing state, observable student responses, scheduling and action costs; alternatively real human pre/post learning outcomes.
research_failure.finding: EduClaw reports never-used adjust_level action and long silent periods with early plateaus. StudentBench instead finds pooled AI equivalent to human short-term GRE tutoring; it does not establish universal weak learning effects.
research_failure.model_setting: See original paper and repository snapshot; not evidence about all current LLMs.
research_failure.scope: Original study conditions only; this exploratory subset cannot estimate the full benchmark.

original_task.input_contract: Original11 learner personas×5 schedules, KT model weights and student simulator;30day timeline.
original_task.scoring_contract: Original30day probe learning gains, proactive support metrics and judge panel; StudentBench real pre/post randomized outcomes.
original_task.environment_contract: EduClaw anonymous repository repeatedly times out; simulator/KTweights unavailable here. StudentBench requires new real learners for a new tutor outcome.

decision.rationale: Cannot replace learned student transitions or real human learning with three scripted dates and call it original learning-gain evaluation.
limitations: Author-repository fetch failed TLS timeout twice; alternative search found unrelated EduClaw software, not the benchmark.
Design evidence does not warrant inventing unvalidated learning-gain ground truth.
